facts.text: CI runs on push and pull_request events targeting main, plus workflow_dispatch.
The workflow declares an empty top-level permissions mapping, so each job grants its own scopes.
Concurrency is grouped by workflow and ref, and cancel-in-progress is true only for pull_request events.
Job dependency-review runs only for pull_request events, on ubuntu-24.04, with a 10-minute timeout.
The Review dependency changes step calls actions/dependency-review-action with fail-on-severity set to moderate.
Job build-test runs on ubuntu-24.04, macos-15 and windows-2025 with fail-fast disabled.
Job build-test has a 30-minute timeout and requests only contents read permission.
On Windows the first step sets core.autocrlf to false globally so line endings stay LF.
Check out uses actions/checkout pinned to v7.0.1 with persist-credentials set to false.
Set up .NET installs dotnet-version 10.0.x.
Restore passes NuGetAuditLevel moderate and turns NU1902, NU1903 and NU1904 warnings into errors.
Build runs dotnet build on Dossier.sln in Release with --no-restore.
Test runs dotnet test on Dossier.sln in Release with --no-build and --minimum-expected-tests 330.
Graph page smoke test runs node scripts/graph-smoke.mjs only when runner.os is Linux.
Job aot-smoke covers linux-x64 on ubuntu-24.04 and linux-arm64 on ubuntu-24.04-arm.
aot-smoke sets VERSION to 0.0.0-ci followed by github.run_number.
aot-smoke pins GLIBC_MAX to 2.39 because the runners are Ubuntu 24.04.
Log resolved AOT toolchain versions fails when Microsoft.DotNet.ILCompiler is absent from project.assets.json.
Fail on trim and AOT warnings exits with an error when publish.log contains a warning whose code starts with IL.
Check glibc baseline fails when no native .so file sits beside the binary in out.
at: no native .so found beside the binary in out/$RID

facts.text: Check binary architecture expects the ELF machine AArch64 for linux-arm64 and Advanced Micro Devices X86-64 for linux-x64.
secret-scan pins GITLEAKS_VERSION to 8.30.1 and verifies the downloaded tarball with sha256sum -c.
Check out full history sets fetch-depth to 0 so gitleaks sees the whole repository history.
Scan git history runs gitleaks git with --redact --no-banner -v and --exit-code 1.
Release concurrency group is release- plus the ref, and cancel-in-progress is false so a run is never cancelled.
Require the tagged commit to be on main runs only for push events and fails if the tagged commit is not an ancestor of origin/main.
On a non-push event, Validate tag and compute version produces 0.0.0-dev followed by the run number.
Validate tag and compute version rejects a tag that does not match vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with an optional prerelease suffix.
Job build has a 45-minute timeout and grants id-token write plus attestations write in addition to contents read.
at: attestations: write # store build provenance attestations

facts.text: Job build depends on verify and reads VERSION from the verify job output.
On Windows the first build step sets core.autocrlf to false before checking out.
Publish (Native AOT) runs dotnet publish for src/Dossier/Dossier.csproj with the RID and the version from verify.
Smoke test runs scripts/smoke-aot.sh with the built executable path and the version.
Package stages the archive under a top-level directory named dossier- followed by the version and the RID.
Package fails when neither libe_sqlite3 nor e_sqlite3 is found in the publish output, because the native library must stay beside the binary.
at: native sqlite library not found in out/$RID

facts.text: Package fails if LICENSE or THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md is missing from the repository root, since both must ship with every binary.
at: $doc not found in the repository root

facts.text: Package copies the NativeAOT runtime pack THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.TXT into the stage as dotnet-runtime-THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.TXT.
For tar archives Package sets COPYFILE_DISABLE to stop macOS bsdtar adding AppleDouble entries.
Verify archive contents fails unless the archive holds exactly the expected entries, rejecting AppleDouble entries and anything outside the folder.
at: does not hold exactly the expected entries

facts.text: Attest build provenance uses actions/attest pinned to v4.2.2 and runs only for push events whose ref starts with refs/tags/v.
Upload archive uses actions/upload-artifact with retention-days 7 and if-no-files-found set to error.
Job release needs build and runs only for a tag push, matching the ref prefix refs/tags/v.
Job release is the only job granted contents write, for gh release create and edit.
at: contents: write # gh release create / edit; the only job that can write

facts.text: Create the release writes SHA256SUMS by running sha256sum over the downloaded dossier archives.
Create the release adds the --prerelease flag when the tag contains a hyphen.
Create the release refuses to modify an existing published release and exits with an error.
at: is already published; refusing to modify it

facts.text: Create the release deletes a leftover draft release for the tag before creating it again.
Create the release finishes by running gh release edit with --draft=false.
Release runs on push of tags starting with the letter v, and on workflow_dispatch as a dry run that never creates a release.
Job verify is skipped when github.event.deleted is true, because deleting a version tag also fires a push event.
Job build produces linux-x64, linux-arm64, win-x64 and osx-arm64 archives, using zip only for win-x64.
Download archives uses actions/download-artifact with the dossier- prefix pattern and merge-multiple true into dist.
Job verify exposes the computed version as an output taken from its version step.
Job verify has a 10-minute timeout and requests only contents read permission.
Validate tag and compute version rejects a tag that fails the grep pattern before it strips the leading v.
Restore in release targets src/Dossier/Dossier.csproj with the RID and PublishAot true rather than the solution.
Job build takes VERSION from the verify job output and passes it to the publish step.
Check glibc baseline in release runs only on Linux and fails when the binary needs a symbol version above 2.39.
Check binary architecture guards against a binary built for the wrong architecture, which would otherwise pass the other checks on its own runner type.
at: A binary built for the wrong architecture would still pass the checks above on its own runner type.

facts.text: Attest build provenance signs the dist archives whose names match the dossier prefix and the matrix rid.
Upload archive names each artifact dossier- followed by the matrix rid.
Job release depends on every build matrix leg succeeding.
Job release has a 15-minute timeout.
Create the release authenticates gh through GH_TOKEN set to the workflow token.
dependabot.yml uses config version 2 and defines updates for the nuget and github-actions ecosystems.
Both ecosystems check weekly with an open-pull-requests-limit of 5.
Each ecosystem sets a cooldown default-days of 7 before an update is proposed.
Groups nuget-minor-patch and actions-minor-patch collect minor and patch updates together.
Both ecosystems scan the repository root because directory is set to slash.
The bug report template applies the bug label to every issue it creates.
The Description and Steps to reproduce textareas are marked required.
The Version or commit input asks for the output of dossier --version or the commit that was built.
at: Output of `dossier --version`, or the commit you built.

facts.text: The Logs or output textarea sets render to shell so pasted output is formatted as a shell block.
The template's markdown body tells reporters not to file security vulnerabilities as issues and links the security policy.
at: Please do not report security vulnerabilities here

facts.text: The issue chooser disables blank issues by setting blank_issues_enabled to false.
A contact link named Report a security vulnerability points to the repository security policy and asks for private reports.
at: about: Please report vulnerabilities privately; do not open a public issue.

facts.text: The feature request template applies the enhancement label.
The Problem and Proposal textareas are required, while Alternatives considered is not.
The pull request checklist asks for tests, a passing local build, docs updates, and no secrets or personal data.
at: Tests added or updated for behaviour changes

facts.text: The template has Summary, Linked issue and Checklist sections.
